title: Advanced Topics in Counseling Children and Adolescents
tagline: The frontier of the field, surveyed.
welcome: The field moves; so must you. This seminar surveys emerging evidence, populations, and methods at the frontier of child and adolescent counseling.
vignette: A seminar debates a new finding: does digital CBT reach adolescents who refuse the clinic? Students weigh evidence, ethics, and access. Advanced study is the discipline of staying current.
vignette_attr: A seminar debate, drawn from experience
description: An advanced seminar on contemporary frontiers: emerging evidence and innovations in youth counseling, technology-delivered interventions, adaptations for underserved and special populations, prevention and public-health approaches, integrated care, and the future of the profession, with critical appraisal throughout.
questions: What is genuinely new, and what is hype?
How do innovations reach underserved young people?
Where is the profession heading, and how do I lead within it?
importance: The evidence base shifts within a career; currency is competence
Innovation can close access gaps for underserved youth
misconceptions: that advanced means complicated, when it means current and critical
that the canon is settled, when the field is alive
figures: who shape what innovation should serve
outcomes: You will critically evaluate new interventions.
You will weigh digital CBT and tele-innovations.
You will think at population level.
You will locate counseling within healthcare.
You will position your practice for what is coming.
modules: You are the field's next chapter.
practicum: A debate on an emerging intervention
An innovation proposal for an underserved group
tips: Read one new study weekly and appraise it
Let equity guide what you call innovation
integration: This capstone elective keeps your whole training current and forward-looking.
faith: We watch the horizon with discernment, holding fast to what is true and open to what is new.
closing: May you remain a student for life, and may the frontier always serve the child.
